releases.summary: Exact Snapshot History Mirror Gate: persistence source correction mirrors into snapshot history only on an exact source timestamp match. The prior same-session/same-bucket fallback was removed; missing or unmatched timestamps fail closed and are recorded instead of mutating another intrahour snapshot. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.

Runtime Error Boundary: captures TAG500-owned script-load failures and critical JavaScript exceptions, records them in Data Integrity, and makes Executive Mode fail closed when runtime safety is compromised. Network-style promise failures remain warnings rather than automatic model failures. No scoring or threshold retune; Final Snapshot Reconciliation remains mandatory.
